Dara Jingga.fact: The Dharmasraya kingdom may have had an alliance with Singhasari in order to face the Mongol invasion. The expedition was sent by Singhasari King Kertanegara in 1275 to conquer Sumatra militarily and diplomatically.

Dara Jingga.question: According to _____, ten days after the expulsion of Mongol forces from Java, the Pamalayu expedition led by Mahisa Anabrang returned to Java
Dara Jingga.fact: According to Pararaton, ten days after the expulsion of Mongol forces from Java, the Pamalayu expedition led by Mahisa Anabrang returned to Java.

Dara Jingga.fact: The expedition was sent by Singhasari King Kertanegara in 1275 to conquer Sumatra militarily and diplomatically.

Dara Jingga.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Jingga.question: The two princesses was originally intended for Kertanagara, however because the Singhasari King died, his heir Raden Wijaya took _____ as his wife
Dara Jingga.fact: The returning Javanese troops brought two Malay princesses, two siblings Dara Jingga and Dara Petak to be presented for Kertanagara. The two princesses was originally intended for Kertanagara, however because the Singhasari King died, his heir Raden Wijaya took Dara Petak as his wife.

Dara Jingga.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Jingga.question: He was sometimes also identified as _____, the leader of the Pamalayu expedition, as he bore the high ranking title of rakryan mahamentri, although this hypothesis needs further evidence
Dara Jingga.fact: He was sometimes also identified as Mahisa Anabrang, the leader of the Pamalayu expedition, as he bore the high ranking title of rakryan mahamentri, although this hypothesis needs further evidence.

Dara Jingga.fact: She probably came back to accompany her son, Adityawarman, appointed by Majapahit King as the ruler of Sumatra under protection of Majapahit mandala.

Dara Jingga.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Jingga.question: The expedition was sent by _____ in 1275 to conquer Sumatra militarily and diplomatically
Dara Jingga.fact: The expedition was sent by Singhasari King Kertanegara in 1275 to conquer Sumatra militarily and diplomatically.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: The _____ was Consort of Raden Wijaya.
Dara Petak.fact: Dara Petak or Dara Pethak, also known in her formal name as Indreswari, was the consort of King Kertarajasa Jayawardhana, the founder of Majapahit kingdom.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: She was a _____ princess from Sumatra and the only non-Javanese wife of Kertarajasa, and also the mother of Jayanegara, the second monarch of Majapahit
Dara Petak.fact: She was a Dharmasraya princess from Sumatra and the only non-Javanese wife of Kertarajasa, and also the mother of Jayanegara, the second monarch of Majapahit.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: The name _____ in old Malay means "white dove", while her other name Indreswari in Sanskrit means "the consort of Indra" and it was acquired after her marriage to Majapahit first king
Dara Petak.fact: Dara Petak or Dara Pethak, also known in her formal name as Indreswari, was the consort of King Kertarajasa Jayawardhana, the founder of Majapahit kingdom. The name Dara Pethak in old Malay means "white dove", while her other name Indreswari in Sanskrit means "the consort of Indra" and it was acquired after her marriage to Majapahit first king.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: This Sumatran kingdom was held as vassal of Singhasari in _____
Dara Petak.fact: This Sumatran kingdom was held as vassal of Singhasari in 1286.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: The expedition was sent by Singhasari King Kertanegara in _____ to conquer Sumatra
Dara Petak.fact: The expedition was sent by Singhasari King Kertanegara in 1275 to conquer Sumatra.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: She acquired the title _____ tinuheng pura, or the most honored wife in the palace
Dara Petak.fact: She acquired the title Stri tinuheng pura, or the most honored wife in the palace.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: According to _____, Raden Wijaya already had four wives, Tribhuwaneswari, Prajnaparamita, Narendra Duhita, and Gayatri Rajapatni; all of them were Singhasari princesses, the daughters of Kertanagara
Dara Petak.fact: According to Nagarakretagama, Raden Wijaya already had four wives, Tribhuwaneswari, Prajnaparamita, Narendra Duhita, and Gayatri Rajapatni; all of them were Singhasari princesses, the daughters of Kertanagara. According to Nagarakretagama, the name of Jayanagara's mother is Indreswari, so it is assumed that this was the new official name of Dara Petak after her marriage to the king.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: In Kertarajasa inscription (_____), Jayanegara was mentioned as the son of Tribhuwaneswari, the prime queen and first wife of Raden Wijaya
Dara Petak.fact: In Kertarajasa inscription (1305), Jayanegara was mentioned as the son of Tribhuwaneswari, the prime queen and first wife of Raden Wijaya.

Dara Petak.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Dara Petak.question: Jayanegara become the successor of _____
Dara Petak.fact: Jayanegara become the successor of King Kertarajasa.

Data link.question: The _____ was Means of connecting one location to another in order to transmit information between them.
Data link.fact: A data link is a means of connecting one location to another for the purpose of transmitting and receiving digital information (data communication).

Data link.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Data link.question: Such systems are used for aircraft crossing the _____, Pacific and Indian oceans
Data link.fact: Such systems are used for aircraft crossing the Atlantic, Pacific and Indian oceans. One such system, used by Nav Canada and NATS over the North Atlantic, uses a five-digit data link sequence number confirmed between air traffic control and the pilots of the aircraft before the aircraft proceeds to cross the ocean.
